description: For every finite tuple \(a:\operatorname{Fin}(n)\to\mathbb N\), there are natural numbers \(c,d\) with \(d>0\) and \(\beta(c,d,i)=a_i\) for every \(i<n\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.beta_codes_finite_tuple (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → ℕ) :
  ∃ c d, 0 < d ∧ ∀ (i : Fin n), Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.beta c d ↑i = a i
